news.title: NEWS
news.lede: Latest signals, exhibitions, films and encounters.
news.panel: Yoshi + Moshi keep showing up. In exhibitions, in films, and sometimes where you least expect them. Not everything makes the news, but some things make it here. Anyway, a few updates below.

entries.html: Big Y+M news: In the spring of 2027, we'll be performing eight shows over four days at a major music and culture festival with 25,000 visitors. It's going to be incredible!

“Universo Immersivo” Yoshi+ Moshi (Chiasso TI, Switzerland)

The performance “Universo Immersivo” explores the tension between the informative overflow, the dissolution of time and the aesthetics of deceleration. The performers Yoshi + Moshi dive with us into their hyperreality, changing the course of things.

performances.title: PERFORMANCES
performances.lede: Big heads, big shows and anything can happen
performances.panel: No words and big ideas. Yoshi + Moshi take the stage, the street or wherever they’re not expected. Things go wrong or wonderfully right. The audience becomes part of the show and nobody knows who's performing for whom.

films.title: FILMS
films.lede: Big heads, big ideas and short films
films.panel: Big heads, bigger ideas and a flair for drama. Yoshi + Moshi turn their wildest ambitions into films, without saying a word but with plenty to tell.

pictures.title: PICTURES
pictures.lede:
A few moments standing still. Yoshi + Moshi
rarely do.
pictures.panel: Yoshi + Moshi are not always easy to pin down. Sometimes a camera helps. On stage, on the road, or somewhere in between — a few moments stayed still long enough to end up here. Anyway, take a look.

about.lede: live and work in Mendrisio TI, Switzerland
about.panel: Yoshi + Moshi are not easy to sum up. They turn up in performances, films and exhibitions, usually with a few surprises. A biography helps, but only up to a point. Here are some selected projects and places.
